en: The postcard shows a sepia-toned image of an ornate, open-air music stage with musicians performing under a decorative structure. To the right is a smaller pavilion or gazebo. The surroundings are lush with trees, and several empty chairs are scattered in the foreground, suggesting a venue for outdoor performances. The word 'Sundsvall' is printed at the top right. There is handwritten text at the bottom of the image. The reverse side includes address lines, a Swedish stamp, and more handwritten text indicating it was mailed within Sweden.
